title: Spider-Man
tagline: Neversoft’s PlayStation Spider-Man, before the films.
summary: Activision’s 2000 game is an original story in a comic-book New York, not a movie adaptation. Neversoft developed the PlayStation version. Other platforms were ported by separate teams and are not credited to Neversoft here.
gameplay: Third-person swinging and combat through enclosed levels. The player unlocks suits and moves between street missions and indoor boss fights.
